title: Platinum Account: Mobile banking and deposit limits
summary: This document covers Platinum Account mobile check deposits and mobile transfers: the daily mobile deposit limit is $50,000, and the maximum total amount you can transfer out per day is $100,000. It also provides endorsement/restrictive-language, imaging, retention-until-available, and transfer submission best practices.
